rationale: Baltimore is 4-2 at home in a division game and has won three straight before a tough road loss at Cleveland; Cincinnati is 1-2 in their last three and Baltimore's home dominance in AFC North games tips this.
Tennessee is 1-5 and has been outscored badly in recent weeks while Cleveland is playing solid complementary football, including a win over Baltimore last week.

Philadelphia has lost four straight and looks like a team in disarray while Dallas has shown some offensive punch recently; slight lean to Dallas in a divisional game where Philly's confidence is shaken.
Denver is 4-2 with wins in three of their last four and Arizona is 2-4 with a weak schedule-adjusted profile; Denver's defense should control a struggling Cardinals offense.
Green Bay is on a three-game win streak including a dominant 31-7 win over Chicago, and Detroit has been inconsistent with a loss to Carolina; division rivalry makes this close but GB has momentum.
Minnesota is 5-0 with a suffocating defense allowing only 9-15 points in recent weeks; Indianapolis is 2-4 and has no answer for a Vikings team playing at home.
Kansas City is 5-0 and playing dominant football while Seattle is 3-3 with three straight losses; the Chiefs' consistency and coaching edge make them clear favorites even on the road.
Both teams are struggling but Las Vegas has home field and has shown more offensive firepower recently; LA has lost three of four and this is a slight lean to the Raiders at home.
Miami is 0-5 and has been outscored badly all season; the Jets get a home division game against the worst team in the AFC and should win comfortably.
Both teams are 4-2 but Chicago has home field and NE is decimated at CB (three CBs out) which is a serious liability against a Bears offense that just beat Philly 27-7.
Houston is at home and has won two straight including a blowout of Tennessee; the Giants just lost to New Orleans and Houston's home environment gives them the edge in a close matchup.
Pittsburgh is 4-2 with a strong defense and has won two straight while New Orleans is 2-4 and has been blown out multiple times recently; the Steelers' defensive identity should travel well.
San Francisco is a perfect 6-0 and has been dominant all season; Atlanta is 2-4 and despite home field, the 49ers are simply on another level right now.
Carolina is 3-2 with three straight wins and has home field in a division game; Tampa Bay is 1-5 and struggling badly, making the Panthers a solid pick here.
